Intrinsically <overload/>Anti-Overload.

Kills or collecting a <void/>Void Breech grants 'Nightsworn Sight' for 7 seconds and Truesight for 3 seconds.

Allies with Slayer's Fang within ? meters of you also recieve the Nightsworn Sight when you score a kill with the gun.

Nightsworn Sight grants the following benefits:
• 15% increased Precision Damage
• 10% increased damage against Fallen and Scorn
• ? Reload Speed
• Submunitions apply <void/>Weaken for 4 seconds and bounce 1 additional time
